feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 July 2026 7:28am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 20 July 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds for a time.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the west of Ireland will continue to extend a ridge eastwards across Britain.


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northwest 4 or 5, but occasionally touching 6 in the northwest of the area for a time later today and at first tonight, from the North Channel to around parts of the west and north of the Isle of Man.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow afternoon or evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
